definition: P := A AND T AND L AND R for the selected movement-evoked signal, consumer and time window
scope_limit: Finite definitional consequence for one declared branch; not a biological impossibility theorem, phenomenal bridge, or consciousness test.

variables.A: declared actual distal movement/contact event occurs
variables.L: the carrier is delivered to the selected consumer
variables.M: verified motor-command intake/use at the selected consumer
variables.R: the consumer reads it inside the declared time window
variables.T: that event is transduced into the declared proprioceptive/state carrier
